subject: requirements-analyst
scenario: A complete feature description is provided with volumes, latency expectations and a compliance obligation stated by the customer.
expected_behaviors: Produces identified functional requirements with testable acceptance criteria.
Quantifies every non-functional dimension the input supports and raises the rest as open questions.
failure_conditions: Merges several behaviours into one untestable requirement.

rubric.criteria: Addressed every element the role's Expected outputs require.
Output is concrete enough for the next role to act on without asking questions.
Artifacts carry identifiers and links per the traceability skill.
